answer: Random peer audit stops sybil floods. Lottery auditors re-check new identities in a crystal clear log. Newcomers must serve five unrelated counterparties before earning, so clones cannot vote. Forging one identity needs a quartz-timed proof of 40 credits plus a 20-credit deposit locked 10 epochs, so 100 fakes cost 6,000 credits as the tide of newcomers is audited. A caught fake loses its deposit; an honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards.
